title: SparSynergy: Unlocking Flexible and Efficient DNN Acceleration Through Multi-Level Sparsity
problem: Value-level and bit-level sparsity in DNNs are typically exploited independently. Joint exploitation of multi-level sparsity presents challenges: increased hardware overhead, bandwidth-intensive multiplexing, and throughput bottlenecks from bit-serial computation.
motivation: Multi-level sparsity offers significant potential for DNN acceleration but is unexplored; understanding how to combine these techniques is critical for efficiency gains.
method: Unified sparsity format and cooptimized hardware design that synergistically integrates value-level and bit-level sparsity. Addresses multiplexing bottlenecks and bit-serial computation inefficiencies through hardware-software codesign.
key_novelty: First accelerator to synergistically combine value-level and bit-level sparsity into a unified framework with cooptimized hardware.
contributions: Unified multi-level sparsity format supporting value and bit-level compression
Cooptimized hardware architecture eliminating multiplexing and bit-serial bottlenecks
5.38x geometric mean improvement in energy-delay product versus tensor core
Improved accuracy retention compared to state-of-the-art sparsity accelerators

metrics.ppa: 5.38x EDP improvement vs tensor core, accuracy retention improved

limitations: Specific workload characteristics and sparsity patterns tested not detailed; scalability across diverse DNN architectures unclear.
primary_theme: Multi-level sparsity integration for efficient DNN acceleration
